(iii) If Qc < Kc, the reaction will proceed in the reverse direction to reach equilibrium. (iv) A negative value for ΔG indicates that the reaction is spontaneous. (v) The reaction quotient Q and the equilibrium constant K are calculated using the same equation. (vi) If Q > K at a given temperature, the reaction will shift toward the reactants.
